newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada Q3 current account again in surplus.
newsitem.headline: Canada Q3 current account again in surplus.

text.p: Canada's current account surplus shrank to C$551 million seasonally adjusted in the third quarter from C$1.09 billion in the previous quarter (revised from C$1.15 billion), Statistics Canada said on Friday.
Note - Figures are in billions of Canadian dollars on a seasonally adjusted basis.
Economists surveyed by Reuters had forecast a current account surplus of C$1.4 billion in the quarter.

The current account moved into surplus last quarter for the first time in more than a decade. The revision in the second quarter surplus was primarily due to a revision in the non-merchandise balance to -C$8.86 billion from -C$8.82 billion.
